items.enzyme_stability: HheG maintains the same activity from pH=7–11. The enzyme is tolerant to high substrate loading (200 mM cyclohexene oxide) in a two-phase system with ethyl acetate, resulting in up to 95% yield. Whole cell and lysate forms show similar reactivity (93–95% yield).
items.special_treatment: Screening was performed in 96-well plates with 50 g/L wet cell, 10 mM cyclohexene oxide, 20 mM NaOCN, 200 μL PB buffer (50 mM, pH=7.0) at 35°C for 16 hrs. Best hit (IcHheG) gave 42% yield at 20 mM substrate. Scale-up used 200 mM cyclohexene oxide, 400 mM NaOCN, 50 g/L wet cell, 35% (v/v) ethyl acetate, pH self-regulated at 10.5, 25°C, 16–29 hrs. Pilot scale: 10 L reaction, 95% conversion, 87% isolated yield, ee=53%. Solvent screening: ethyl acetate (95% yield, pH 10.5), heptane (29%, pH 13.0), n-butanol (25%, pH 13.0), toluene (29%, pH 13.0), MTBE (31%, pH 13.0), dichloromethane (<1%, pH 10.5), none (<1%, pH 10.5). Substrate/product solubility (g/100g): HBC: <0.01 (water), 5 (ethyl acetate), <0.01 (heptane); cyclohexene oxide: <1 (water), >100 (ethyl acetate, heptane); NaOCN: 11 (water), <0.01 (ethyl acetate, heptane).
